notes: https://www.commvault.com/careers/jobs is server-rendered: it ships const greenhouse_list (Greenhouse job ids), 56 .job-card elements and a form#job-filters whose radio/select controls are named filters[department], filters[hiring_type], filters[country], filters[state], filters[remote_position], each with All/Total counts; the visible keyword box is <input type=text name=search-jobs>. The page's own greenhouse.js only hides/shows those already-rendered cards (no listing request, no pagination, no URL-parameter search), so every filter is a client-side control: native_param records the observed form field name purely as evidence, and there is no server-side query to send. Counts at capture: Department total 56 (Corporate 5, Sales & Sales Engineering 29, Enterprise & Customer Support 1, Services 3, Marketing 3, IT 4, Engineering & Product 10, Security 1); Hiring Type Full Time 55 / Other 1; Remote Yes 30 / No 26.
